description: This file contains miscellaneous utility functions for the ADODB database abstraction layer in PHP. It includes functions for array manipulation, SQL query construction (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, COUNT), pagination, debug logging, and other helper methods used internally by the ADODB library.

methods.name: _array_change_key_case
methods.description: Converts all array keys to uppercase.

methods.name: _adodb_replace
methods.description: Performs an INSERT or UPDATE operation on a database table based on provided data, handling quoting and key columns.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with options populated from a database recordset.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_gp
methods.description: Similar to _adodb_getmenu but supports grouped options.

methods.name: _adodb_getcount
methods.description: Estimates the number of records that an SQL query will return, with query rewriting heuristics for efficiency.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_all_rows
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated set of rows from a query, handles counting total records and setting pagination properties.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_no_last_page
methods.description: Retrieves a page of data, with logic to determine if it is the last page.

methods.name: _adodb_getupdatesql
methods.description: Constructs an UPDATE SQL statement based on modified fields in a recordset.

methods.name: adodb_key_exists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a key in an array, with optional null/empty handling.

methods.name: _adodb_getinsertsql
methods.description: Builds an INSERT SQL statement from a recordset or table name and field values.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql_oci8
methods.description: Handles special SQL generation for BLOB and long data types in Oracle (oci8 driver).

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL for a specific column, properly quoting and formatting based on its data type and database driver.

methods.name: _adodb_debug_execute
methods.description: Logs and executes an SQL statement with debugging information.

methods.name: _adodb_backtrace
methods.description: Outputs a debug backtrace for debugging purposes.
